accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Predictable quadratic-variation stabilization for the exact unit-then-label reveal martingale is assumed, not derived from bounded composition schedules alone.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The centered CLT, Wald coverage, sparse-beyond-birthday studentization, and CR2 frontier are conditional on Q_n/σ_n²→p1; the exact variance and dense degree-one correction remain unconditional under their displayed design assumptions.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 1–2 require n,N,G_N→∞ with N²/n→0 and give asymptotic normality plus ratio consistency of the cluster-robust variance estimator for the random-group PAME case.
The slice harmonic basis supplies eigenspaces for the Johnson and Kneser graphs.
The Kneser adjacency eigenvalues are (-1)^i binom(n-d-i,d-i); normalizing by its degree yields the stated falling-factorial multiplier.
CR2 is exactly unbiased when its working covariance model and rank conditions hold.
The paper studies optimized conservative variance bounds under interference and complex designs; Theorem 1 gives conservative, estimable, admissible bounds under a strictly monotone objective.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Derive predictable-quadratic-variation stabilization from checkable primitive restrictions on the composition schedule, rather than retaining it as a class-membership condition; this would turn the inference portion into a fully primitive design-based result.

Add a computable conservative variance bound or correction that uses an explicitly stated structural restriction, repeated regrouping, or an estimable proxy for the degree-one energy, thereby pairing the CR2 diagnosis with an actionable remedy.
State the strict comparison to FuSamiiWang2026 at its exact Theorems 1–2 regime boundary in the theorem headline or corollary, including the N=n^(3/4) sequence and the predictable-variation premise.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the accepted predictable-variation conditionality fixed in the headline; prioritize proving or primitively characterizing that stabilization condition.
